clips.title: Meeting Whisper the Yo-kai
grammar: 〜と言ったところ — what you might call

lines.ja: わたくしめはウィスパー！
lines.speaker: Whisper

lines.ja: あなた達人間世界で言うところの、妖怪です！
lines.en: In what you in the human world call it, I am a Yo-kai!
lines.speaker: Whisper

lines.en: A Yo-kai? You mean a ghost?
lines.speaker: Keita

lines.ja: 人間と私達妖怪のコミュニケーションツールです！
lines.en: It's a communication tool between humans and us Yo-kai!
lines.speaker: Whisper

lines.ja: これを付ければ、喧嘩もきっと治められますよ！
lines.en: If you put this on, you'll surely be able to stop their fight!
lines.speaker: Whisper

clips.title: Jibanyan Remembers His Past Life
grammar: 〜てもらう — to receive the favor of having someone do

lines.ja: 俺っちは生きてた頃、エミちゃんって子に飼ってもらってたにゃん。
lines.en: When I was alive, I was kept as a pet by a girl named Emi-chan, nyan.
lines.speaker: Jibanyan

lines.ja: 今はジバニャンって名前にゃけど、本当は違う名前をつけてもらってたにゃん。
lines.en: Now my name is Jibanyan, but actually I had been given a different name, nyan.
lines.speaker: Jibanyan

lines.ja: それはもう、素敵かつ格好良く、紳士的な名前にゃん！
lines.en: It was truly wonderful, cool, and gentlemanly, nyan!
lines.speaker: Jibanyan

lines.ja: ですからどんなお名前を？
lines.en: So, what kind of name was it?
lines.speaker: Whisper
